detail.command:
set -e
perl -pi -e 's/\[(\d+)\]\./[$1]!./g' src/obstacles/obstacles.test.ts src/obstacles/spinnerWindmill.test.ts
perl -pi -e 's/= physics\.bodies\[0\];/= physics.bodies[0]!;/' src/obstacles/obstacles.test.ts
perl -pi -e 's/= body\.rotations\[body\.rotations\.length - 1\];/= body.rotations[body.rotations.length - 1]!;/' src/obstacles/obstacles.test.ts
set +e
LOG=/private/tmp/claude-501/-/878caa08-6b06-497e-8e8f-f501167a423a/scratchpad
mkdir -p "$LOG"
npx tsc -b --pretty false > "$LOG/typecheck2.log" 2>&1; tc=$?
tail -25 "$LOG/typecheck2.log"
echo "typecheck exit: $tc"
npx vitest run src/obstacles > "$LOG/vitest2.log" 2>&1; vt=$?
tail -12 "$LOG/vitest2.log"
echo "vitest exit: $vt"
npm run build > "$LOG/build2.log" 2>&1; bd=$?
tail -18 "$LOG/build2.log"
echo "build exit: $bd"
